- issues opened in `paper-repo`#8 ("Figures after Outline rev 8: Fig 3 redrawn, floor b by B, M5 robustness, Table 3 saving CI, Fig 1 second instance") by `figtab-repo`  > Delivered on `dev` (43747f3), all built from `results/tables` at the current `dev`; each figure's `.json` has the note with what it was computed on. Changes the text must follow (Outline rev 8):
  > 
  > 1. **Fig 3 (`fig3_margin`) is redrawn from `margin_strata.csv`.** It shows, per dataset × model and margin quartile Q1–Q4, the share of instances with P_c ≥ 0.9 (strict, 95% CI over instances), the share with P_c^ε ≥ 0.9 (dotted), and the share with a flat tolerance group (grey bars). n per quartile is 10 (German), 15 (ACS Employment), 25 (d ≤ 10) and is in the panel title: the intervals are wide. The d ≤ 10 panels are at a sampled budget (127 / 511), not the default (the default enumerates). The old "mean P_c 0.84–0.95 in Q1" no longer matches the figure; the caption/text should read share P_c ≥ 0.9 in Q1 (German 0.60–0.80, ACS Employment 0.80–0.87 for RF/GBM/MLP; see `figures/fig3_margin.csv`), 1.0 in Q2–Q4 except where the csv says otherwise, and say that the tolerance-aware share is 1 almost everywhere because P_c^ε is vacuous inside a flat group. Figure height is now about 4.5 in (was 4.3).
  > 2. **New `fig7_floor_b` (floor b by B, main-text candidate, 3.7 in tall) and `figA_floor_b_sampled` (same for d ≤ 10 at the largest sampled budget, appendix).** Top: floor b for B=20/50/200 random rows and 50 k-means medoids, next to floor a (run-to-run agreement) of the shap default (filled) and paired Kernel (open) on the same instances. Bottom: paired difference floor b − floor a with CI. The figure shows what Outline rev 8 states: floor b rises with B and lies below the shap default's floor a in every d ≥ 16 row; against paired Kernel the difference is mixed (positive for B=200 and k-means on ACS Employment). Titles give n and K per model (ACS Employment MLP n=10, K=6, no B=50 row yet; German MLP has no floor b by B). Caption must label estimator and budget of floor a (the json has them).
  > 3. **New appendix figure `figB_m5_robust`**: (a–c) collapse of the share correct on x = g√m/σ against Φ(x) for antithetic permutation, shap default, paired Kernel (m_eff ≥ 256, σ_loo, German and ACS Employment, RF/GBM/MLP); (d) probit slope β per estimator and budget range (H3: 1; the upper bound 20 is a search bound and drawn to the axis edge); (e) Tobit slope under grid thinning (H3: −2). Reading in the figure: permutation collapses (β 0.9–1.05), the shap default collapses only at large budgets, paired Kernel stays below 1; paired Kernel's Tobit slope depends on the grid (−1.4…−1.8 full / every 2nd, −0.65…−1.1 every 3rd), permutation's does not. Outline rev 8 wording: supported for permutation, unresolved elsewhere, never "refuted".
  > 4. **Table 3 (b)** now gives, per dataset (four models pooled), the saving of the budget rule with its CI: German 20% [17, 24], ACS Employment 23% [18, 28], ACS Income 1.7% [1.2, 2.4], GMSC 1.4% [1.0, 1.9], Pima n.a.; run-twice is negative everywhere. The pooled "≈ 25%" must not be written.
  > 5. **Fig 1** now has two instances (German RF, shap default, m=2088, 100 runs): instance 27 (exact margin 0.0077, exact set in 86/100 runs) and instance 36 (0.081, 100/100). The README of analysis says they are fixed by position in the margin order (the second was added to show a small-margin instance, one of 40, not a frequency). The caption must say that. Fig 1 is now 4 panels tall (about 4.1 in).
  > 6. **`figA_background`** is rebuilt on the complete background tables (German RF 10, GBM/MLP 20 instances; ACS Employment 30). Panel (b) is the paired difference of the **mean P_c** (share of runs correct, averaged over instances; each run scored against the exact φ of its own background), not of the share of instances with P_c ≥ 0.9; the P_c^ε differences are exactly 0. Please use that wording; the old caption's "share" wording was mine and wrong.
  > 7. **Table 2** now reads the `criterion` column of `guidance.csv` instead of inferring it; the entries are unchanged.
